entities.summary: The Battle of Tondibi was the decisive confrontation in the 16th-century invasion of the Songhai Empire by the army of the Saadi dynasty. The Saadi forces under Judar Pasha defeated the Songhai under Askia Ishaq II, guaranteeing the empire's downfall.
